answer_2.quote: We evaluated CER on two realistic web benchmarks WEBARENA and VISUALWEBARENA... On WEBARENA, CER shows a relative improvement of 51.0% over the GPT-4o baseline and achieves an overall success rate of 36.7%... On VISUALWEBARENA, CER outperforms the tree search based method by 20.8% in relative performance with dozens of times fewer token costs...
